ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) with high-intensity (white) pixels accounting for approximately 5-8% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white clusters located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; a localized white patch adjacent to the median notch on the left lateral side; sparse white mottling and fine points distributed across the upper half of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 95 degrees and moderate depth relative to the vertical axis of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the full trailing edge; amplitude of peaks increases significantly toward the distal tips, characterized by jagged, uneven notches.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the leading edges, tapering to sharp, irregular points at the distal ends with a slight upward sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated white circular clusters at the distal tip of the right lobe; isolated small white circular points scattered across the central region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct white linear rake marks; two parallel diagonal lines on the left lobe; a network of intersecting, unaligned linear streaks on the upper-central region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple sets of parallel rake marks (likely odontocete-induced) across both lobes; irregular deep nicks on the trailing edge of the right lobe distal tip.
